**[[Cyclone Freddy]]
***Cyclone Freddy kills at least 99 people in [[Malawi]], including 85 people in [[Blantyre]]. It is the longest-lived [[tropical cyclone]] on record, according to the [[World Meteorological Organization|WMO]], having formed on February 4.
